from pathlib import Path
src=bytearray(Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/jbig2dec/annex-h.jbig2').read_bytes())
# try a few targeted mutations in the body after header
for off in range(64, min(len(src), 860), 8):
    d=bytearray(src)
    d[off] ^= 0x01
    p=Path('/tmp/mut.jb2')
    p.write_bytes(d)
    import subprocess, os
    r=subprocess.run(['bash','-lc',f'LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$PWD/.libs ./.libs/jbig2dec -q -o /dev/null /tmp/mut.jb2 >/tmp/out 2>&1; echo $?'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    code=int(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1]) if r.stdout.strip() else 999
    out=Path('/tmp/out').read_text(errors='ignore').strip().splitlines()[-1:] if Path('/tmp/out').exists() else []
    if code!=0:
        print('off',off,'code',code,'out',out)
        break
else:
    print('no crash')
